contract.reader: An engineer or student who has followed entry 2 (scan cycle, response time) and now meets distributed I/O, drives and plant networks
contract.problem: Why a control network must be deterministic, and how fieldbuses and industrial Ethernet systems achieve or fail to achieve bounded latency and jitter
contract.outcome: Compute a Modbus RTU poll cycle and a CAN frame's worst case and bus load; trace CAN arbitration; compute Ethernet frame times and switch blocking; explain PROFINET RT/IRT, EtherCAT, POWERLINK, PTP and TSN; choose an approach by timing need
contract.contribution: One timing argument carried from serial polling to TSN, each step with numbers reproduced by runnable code, and a comparison organized by where determinism comes from
contract.evidence: Three Python programs with real output; Davis et al. (2007); IEC 61158, IEC 61784-1-0/-2-0:2023, IEC/IEEE 60802:2026, IEC 61131-9, IEEE 1588, 802.1AS, 802.1Q, 802.3, ISO 11898-1:2024, Modbus specifications
contract.limitations: Protocol survey, not an implementation guide; product-dependent parameters labeled; no wireless; network security deferred to entry 5
